name: DETOUR LAB demonstration rulepack (NOT a legal standard)
basis: Synthetic demonstration thresholds selected only to exercise the evaluation engine. Values are not derived from any statutory instrument and have not been reviewed by an accessibility professional.
disclaimer: Modeled checks only. 'Pass' means every applicable check in this demonstration rulepack was satisfied by the evidence available. It is not legal compliance, professional approval, or a statement that anyone can physically travel the route.

width_mm.description: Clear width of the walking surface, canonicalised to integer millimetres.

slope_percent.description: Signed longitudinal grade in percent along the direction of travel u->v. Positive is a rise.

curb_transition.description: Transition type at a curb or crossing interface.

crossing_type.description: Crossing control type. An explicit freshness policy applies because crossing layouts change; a record without an observed date cannot be shown to be current.

rules.description: Footway clear width for the demo manual-wheelchair profile.
rules.failure_message: Modelled clear width is below the demo manual-wheelchair threshold.
rules.source_reference: Synthetic demonstration threshold. Inspiration noted for review: public right-of-way accessibility guidance on clear width (e.g. US Access Board PROWAG R302) - applicability to any jurisdiction is unverified.

rules.description: Footway clear width for the demo limited-mobility walking profile.
rules.failure_message: Modelled clear width is below the demo limited-mobility walking threshold.
rules.source_reference: Synthetic demonstration threshold. No statutory basis claimed.

rules.description: Uphill gradient in the direction of travel, demo manual-wheelchair profile.
rules.failure_message: Uphill gradient exceeds the demo manual-wheelchair threshold in the direction of travel.
rules.source_reference: Synthetic demonstration threshold. Inspiration noted for review: accessible route gradient provisions (e.g. US Access Board PROWAG R302) - applicability unverified.

rules.description: Downhill gradient in the direction of travel, demo manual-wheelchair profile.
rules.failure_message: Downhill gradient exceeds the demo manual-wheelchair threshold in the direction of travel.

rules.description: Uphill gradient in the direction of travel, demo limited-mobility walking profile.
rules.failure_message: Uphill gradient exceeds the demo limited-mobility walking threshold in the direction of travel.

rules.description: Downhill gradient in the direction of travel, demo limited-mobility walking profile.
rules.failure_message: Downhill gradient exceeds the demo limited-mobility walking threshold in the direction of travel.

rules.description: Surface category acceptable to the demo manual-wheelchair profile.
rules.failure_message: Declared surface is outside the demo manual-wheelchair profile's modelled surface set.

rules.description: Surface category acceptable to the demo limited-mobility walking profile.

checks.description: Firm running surface, compacted fine gravel permitted.

rules.failure_message: Declared surface is outside the demo limited-mobility walking profile's modelled surface set.

rules.description: Curb transition at an interface usable by the demo manual-wheelchair profile.

checks.description: Transition must be flush, bevelled or ramped.

rules.failure_message: Curb transition is not one of the modelled usable transition types.

rules.description: Curb transition at an interface usable by the demo limited-mobility walking profile.

checks.description: Transition must be flush, bevelled, ramped or assisted.

rules.failure_message: Curb transition is not one of the modelled usable transition types.

rules.description: Crossing control type at a crossing interface.
rules.failure_message: Crossing type is not one of the modelled usable crossing types.

rules.description: Demo manual-wheelchair profile prefers the smoothest running surface when several confirmed routes exist. This preference can influence route ranking only; it can never change a hard verdict.
rules.failure_message: Surface is acceptable but not preferred for route ranking.
rules.source_reference: Demonstration preference weight; no accessibility standard sets a preference ordering.
